flood.title: Flooding · 12 July 2021-type design storm · 4 m grid

limits: Wind: geometry-initialised SCALED V1 rollout from a uniform 1 m/s westerly inflow; no CFD reference; east-boundary inflow cells show a numerical speed-up after ~1500 s.
Temperature: controlled clear-sky surface energy balance and 3-D advection-diffusion under the frozen final wind; 600 s response, not measured weather.
Sunlight: clear-sky ShadowNet/HorizonNet on 2.5-D buildings; no clouds or facades.
Controlled 2-D near-ground passive tracer, not 3-D dispersion or calibrated pollution/health exposure.
Uniform arbitrary source rate on mapped road cells, not measured emissions.
Frozen final SCALED 6 m horizontal wind; no vertical exchange, chemistry or deposition.
Wind model step and tracer elapsed time are independent clocks.
Flood: uniform 50 mm / 90 min design storm, 12 mm/h drainage, 20 mm/h infiltration on green cells; not the observed 2021 event.
Browser fields use declared 8-bit PNG/WebP quantization; complete scientific arrays remain in retained runs.

Close-up geometry streams 1 km detail tiles and high-detail landmarks from the Imperial Corridor presentation (resource west_london_8km_geometry_detail_tiles_20261030); overview uses the coarse extruded model.
